title: title
description: Controls the text and behavior for screen titles using plain text.

player.title: player
player.description: A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

titletext.title: titleText
titletext.description: A `plain text` `string`  for the title text.

fadein.title: fadeIn
fadein.description: The number of gameticks for the title to fade in. Default: `10`.

stay.title: stay
stay.description: The number of gameticks for the title to stay. Default: `70`.

fadeout.title: fadeOut
fadeout.description: The number of gameticks for the title to fade out. Default: `20`.
